actions: 以管理员 nocobase 登录 http://127.0.0.1:13000/main/，进入 Document library，确认三条资料 A/B/C 均在列表中并带 Edit/Delete。
管理员打开资料 B 的 Edit document 弹窗，确认 Title/Content 原值正确回填，将巡检间隔由 45 天改为 60 天并点击 Save，页面出现 Document saved；刷新后列表仍显示 60 天。
管理员打开 Document assistant，确认显示 The assistant is unavailable / The AI service is not configured / No AI model is enabled，并可通过 Open the document library 回到资料页。
退出并以普通同事 colleague 登录，session 确认为 colleague@example.com；进入 Document library 仅见 A/B 两行、无 C、无 Edit/Delete 操作列。

以 colleague 浏览器会话实际调用接口：POST documentsMaterials:findMany 返回 doc-a/doc-b 两条；POST findOne(filter id=doc-c) 返回 {"data":null}；POST findMany(filter id=doc-c) 返回 {"data":[]}；POST createOne 返回 403 FORBIDDEN。
以 colleague 直接打开 /main/materials/doc-c，URL 被重定向到 /main，页面未出现任何 C 内容。
以 colleague 打开 Document assistant，显示未配置/不可用状态，点击 Open the document library 可正常进入资料页；刷新资料页后 A/B 仍在（B 为 60 天）。
退出并以资料主管 supervisor 登录，session 确认为 supervisor@example.com；Document library 显示 A/B/C 三条且带 Edit/Delete；接口 findMany 返回三条，findOne(doc-c) 返回 C 的内容。
evidence: 管理员与资料主管均可查看/维护 A/B/C；编辑弹窗原值回填正确，将 B 改为 60 天保存成功，刷新后仍为 60 天，证明保存与持久化正常。
普通同事 colleague 页面仅显示 A 与 B，不显示 C，也没有编辑/删除操作；接口 findMany 只返回 doc-a/doc-b，doc-c 的 findOne 为 null、findMany 为空数组，createOne 为 403 FORBIDDEN，未泄露 C 且保持只读。
普通同事直接打开 C 的页面地址被重定向回 /main，页面级访问被拒绝。
资料主管 supervisor 接口可读取 doc-c，说明 C 的主管可见权限正确。
三种身份打开 Document assistant 均显示真实未配置/不可用状态，且资料页在三种身份下都可正常打开。
全程未出现 Something went wrong、空白页或未处理异常；console 与 page errors 为空，网络请求均为 200（colleague 写入 403 为预期只读行为）。

rawRetro.summary: Repaired the three failing app-server tests, then built the missing document-assistant frontend. Server: application service providers now tolerate a runtime composed without the optional authorization/AI-employee plugins, the documents seed encodes the Permission Set title as the JSON the store decodes, and the documents API scopes authentication to its own Repository action paths instead of a catch-all that swallowed unregistered /api requests. Frontend: registered the `materials` and `assistant` app routes with page authz ids matching the seed grants, added the document library page (read view for everyone, create/edit/delete gated on the `documents.materials` `manage` composite grant) and the read-only assistant page (advances from the AI configuration signal, no attachments or web search, and a clear unavailable state with a link to the library when no model is enabled), and added the en-US/zh-CN strings. Verified with the client-routes, route-navigation, plugin-page-authz, client-shell, locale-coverage and documents-api tests, client typecheck, scoped lint/format, and a full pnpm build.

improvements.title: Seed page-grant ids had no matching route
improvements.detail: The documents seed granted page access to ids "materials" and "assistant", but no route declared those page ids, so the Users Permissions list showed an empty page section and the pages were unreachable until client/routes.ts declared matching authz ids.
improvements.suggestedChange: Add a logic test that reads every page grant id used by seeds and migrations and fails when no registered app route declares the same authz.resource.id.

issues.title: ESLint unsafe-any errors in server/ai/tools/search-materials.ts and server/routes/documents.ts
issues.symptom: eslint . --max-warnings 0 failed with 5 errors: unsafe assignment/member access on args.query and Reflect.get(body, 'values').
issues.rootCause: The tool invoke signature types args as any, so reading args.query produced unsafe member access and an any-typed query value. Reflect.get returns any and was assigned directly to values.
issues.resolution: Factored the tool's zod object out of the definition and parse args via searchMaterialsSchema.safeParse(args as unknown), yielding a typed query. Annotated the Reflect.get result as unknown.

issues.title: DocumentsProvider.boot failed on a runtime composed without the authorization plugin
issues.symptom: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts > registers application-owned providers and routes from the runtime: Service "@nocobase/app/authorization" is not registered from server/providers/documents.ts:93.
issues.rootCause: DocumentsProvider.boot() and AIResourcesProvider.boot() resolved authorizationToken/aiManagerToken unconditionally, but the template test composes a runtime whose plugins array is empty, so those plugin-owned services are absent.
issues.resolution: Guard both boot() methods with this.app.container.has(token) and skip when the optional plugin service is not registered; the real runtime still has the tokens and registers the collection/composite as before.

issues.title: Documents seed stored a Permission Set title that startup could not decode
issues.symptom: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts > serves Users and API Keys / starts a fresh Default: SyntaxError: Unexpected token '资', "资料同事 / Doc"... is not valid JSON in decodeAuthorizationTitle.
issues.rootCause: The seed inserted title: set.title directly into authorizationPermissionSets, but the Permission Set store reads that column with decodeAuthorizationTitle, which JSON.parses it; every other writer uses encodeAuthorizationTitle (JSON.stringify).
issues.resolution: Store JSON.stringify(set.title ?? set.key) in the seed, the encoded representation the store expects.

issues.title: Documents route catch-all auth middleware broke the SPA fallback for unregistered /api paths
issues.symptom: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts > starts a fresh Default without example tables or APIs: GET /api/articles, /api/example, /api/routes-example returned 401 instead of the SPA fallback 200 html.
issues.rootCause: server/routes/documents.ts installed authentication with router.use('*', ...) on a router mounted at the /api root, so every unregistered /api request hit the auth check instead of falling through to the SPA route.
issues.resolution: Bind the authentication and authorization middleware to each owned Repository action path (/documentsMaterials:<action>) as the file plugin does, leaving unmatched paths to fall through.

issues.title: Document assistant feature had a complete backend but no reachable frontend
issues.symptom: Signing in showed only the Home item in the main navigation. There was no document library page, no assistant page, and no UI for the "no LLM service configured" state. The Users page Permissions list showed the "资料主管/资料同事" sets with no grantable pages, because the page grants named ids no registered route declared.
issues.rootCause: The feature had been delivered server-only: the documents collection, seed (three documents, two permission sets, two accounts), Repository API, AI employee and searchMaterials tool all existed, but nothing registered client routes or pages. A page grant whose resource id matches no route is inert, so the permission sets could not surface or open anything.
issues.resolution: Declared `materials` and `assistant` routes in client/routes.ts with authz.resource.id equal to the seed page-grant ids, and navigation entries. Added client/pages/materials (lists documentsMaterials:findMany scoped by the API to the caller, supervisor create/edit/delete gated on useCan composite `documents.materials` manage) and client/pages/assistant (NocoBaseAIRootProvider readiness gate, then a read-only AIChatProvider/AIChatWindow pinned to materials-assistant with showEmployeeSelector=false and no attachments/web search; an unavailable Alert links to the library when no model is enabled). Added nested materials.*/assistant.* and navigation.* strings to en-US and zh-CN.
